name: Ranch Bot
tagline: Six plain-language logbooks for running a Texas ranch day to day
description: Keeps the operating record of a working ranch in six separate books, covering wildlife and game, the roads, surface notes for oil-and-gas activity, water, machinery, and the homestead. Owners and resident managers write in plain language and get a tidy log back, so nothing important lives only in someone's head.
author: JC
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
